history.recommendation_text: 44. The Board recommends that the Administration implement the tools necessary for a competitive selection process of consultants and individual contractors and provide adequate guidance to missions in accordance with ST/AI/2013/4. Travel management
history.reference_raw: A/72/5 (Vol. II), chap. II, for the year ended 30 June 2017; para. 301
history.administration_response: The Administration stated that the function to circulate job openings in order to select consultants and individual contractors on a competitive basis has been available in Inspira on a pilot basis since 2015. The module is also planned to be made available to field missions on a pilot basis.
history.board_assessment: The module was rolled out to all missions on 1 October 2018. The recommendation has been implemented.
